observed_bottleneck: Algorithm Node n-ad8b380d9b4e exited on all five seed-0 objectives because PrefixTreeSearch.suggest raised after producing only 7 to 9 of the 10 required molecules within the fixed 2500 local rollouts, leaving every objective incomplete and without a macro score.
hypothesis: Close only the newly expanded prefix leaf after its recurrent rollout is incomplete or its completed terminal is canonical-invalid, so the next traversal cannot immediately expand that already failed leaf and instead continues the same frozen-prior UCT search through another available branch.
method_name: ChemTS-style RNN-guided Monte Carlo tree search
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.
